scope: Archive-only history of the convective Allen-Cahn gravity and hydrostatic mass-conservation missions m23012 and m23170. The first recorded run failed. The later Phase A report asserts a pass without a separate machine-readable result in that mission directory. Source paths are frozen historical snapshots, not provenance of an independently reproduced run and not a supported runner.
